values.note: First-come, first-served only: 'Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site' (self-pay station). One RV or two tents, two vehicles and eight people per site. Onsite host.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/brandywine-recreation-area ('This campground operates on a first-come, first-served basis.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10158455 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Mid-May through Mid-December' (Forest Service Seasons of Use). Water is winterized in freezing weather, when the $10 non-peak rate applies.
Showers and water are seasonal; water is winterized when temperatures fall below freezing. Each site has a tent pad, picnic table, lantern post and grill; swimming beach on the 10-acre lake.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/brandywine-recreation-area ('Dump station is available', Restrooms 'Flush Toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10158455 ('Bath houses have hot showers and flush toilets, drinking water available'; amenities 'Showers (Seasonal)', 'Water (Seasonal)'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/brandywine-recreation-area ('The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Passes provide a 50% discount to the base campsite fee (not hook ups) and day use fees.'), read 2026-10-21

note: There is a small lake nearby, but the campground is not on the lake. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + rec.gov FCFS listing: confirmed first-come only (self-pay), $20 peak / $10 non-peak (fees unchanged, already from this page), Senior/Access 50% discount. Added season mid-May to mid-December, flush toilets/showers/water (seasonal)/dump. Not stated: site count, max length ('Not suitable for large RVs'), hookups. Note trimmed of the FCFS sentence.
